title: HOLD-LC-001 TTE event-row feature index
purpose: Advance the unchanged observation-first P1 intake by extracting only detector-frame TTE event rows from the already hash-pinned Fermi products into a deterministic candidate-neutral histogram. This is a source-data feature index, not a likelihood, covariance, dynamics owner, or candidate score.

columns.name: TIME
columns.physical_rule: raw IEEE-754 big-endian float64 multiplied by TSCAL1 (default 1) and shifted by TZERO1

columns.name: PHA
columns.physical_rule: signed big-endian 16-bit integer multiplied by TSCAL2 (default 1) and shifted by TZERO2 (default 0)

histogram.definition: For each event, r=(TIME_physical-TRIGTIME) seconds and k=floor(r/1 second). Count events in the half-open bins [k,k+1).
histogram.channel_rule: all PHA channels admitted by the EVENTS table; require every decoded physical PHA to be an integer in [0,127]

checks: FITS byte length is block aligned and every HDU data span is in bounds.
EVENTS schema is exactly TIME 1D followed by PHA 1I with row width derived from the header.
Every decoded time and PHA is finite and every event lies in the header TSTART/TSTOP interval.
Event times are nondecreasing in file order.
Histogram bin counts are nonnegative and conserve all decoded event rows.
The two products use identical trigger-relative bin edges and one-second width.
exact_scope.limit_order: none; finite raw-row feature extraction only
exact_scope.volume: the finite event tables and their header-declared GTI interval
exact_scope.boundary_condition: not applicable to detector-frame event rows
exact_scope.normalization: raw event counts; no response, exposure or likelihood normalization

assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains authoritative for product identity, local cache keys, byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
FITS binary-table scalar layout is big-endian as declared by the standard and the selected TTE headers.
TIME is converted only with the per-table TSCAL/TZERO metadata; no detector-to-geocenter or leap-second conversion is inferred.
The one-second trigger-relative histogram rule is frozen before any candidate comparison and is not fitted to a candidate.
Reading raw TTE rows is an additive source-feature operation and does not authorize response, likelihood or physical-map admission.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned or independently reproduced calibration release and validity/interpolation rule.
A common time-standard and detector-to-geocenter transformation with uncertainty.
A fixed source-owned detector, energy, background and onset-selection rule.
A joint timing likelihood or covariance including calibration, shared-source and selection terms.
A preregistered intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or calibrated set-valued scoring rule.
A complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs microscopic map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.
evidence_level: T0 exact hash-pinned raw-row extraction with independent parser, hostile mutations and Lean arithmetic cross-check
non_claims: The event histogram is a detector-frame descriptive feature and is not a timing likelihood, confidence region or covariance estimate.
It does not supply a geocenter correction, calibration validity, intrinsic-emission law, microscopic dynamics, physical projection or candidate score.
It does not prove Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, a continuum limit, cosmic origin, a theory of everything or a mass gap.
It does not replace the Reading-H physical-empty branch or any existing T-054 forward proof step.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse method, owner order and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
falsifiers: Any source hash or byte-length mismatch.
A malformed EVENTS table, unsupported column format, out-of-bounds row span or non-finite decoded value.
A time outside the header interval, a decreasing event sequence or a PHA outside [0,127].
Histogram conservation, common-edge, digest or primary/independent parity failure.
Any attempt to read response coefficients, infer geocenter timing, admit a likelihood/covariance, or score a candidate from this feature index.
Any method, owner-order, prospective-lock or physical-scope promotion mutation.

adversarial_review.objection: A changed event file could be accepted if only its row count is checked.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: parent SHA-256 and byte length are checked before row decoding.

adversarial_review.objection: A wrong row width or column offset could create a plausible histogram.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: EVENTS headers must declare TIME 1D then PHA 1I and the row width is derived and checked.

adversarial_review.objection: Raw TIME could be mistaken for an absolute or geocentric timestamp.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: only table TSCAL/TZERO and TRIGTIME are used; geocenter and time-standard flags remain false.

adversarial_review.objection: Changing closed/open endpoint convention after seeing the rows could alter counts.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: one-second left-closed/right-open bins and header-derived edges are fixed in the contract and mutation-tested.

adversarial_review.objection: A favorable PHA subset could be silently selected.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: all decoded channels are required to lie in the declared [0,127] range and no subset is selected.

adversarial_review.objection: One parser could hide a byte-order or offset bug.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: an independently written standard-library parser must reproduce the canonical feature core digest.

adversarial_review.objection: A histogram could be presented as the published 1.74 +/- 0.05 s timing likelihood.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: likelihood, covariance and nuisance admission remain false and the retrospective lock is empty.

adversarial_review.objection: Raw-row extraction could silently replace the established forward or inverse proof route.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: this is an additive F_reg feature slot only; T-054/T-059/T-061 authorities and owner order are unchanged.

adversarial_review.objection: Detector-frame features could be called a causal, QFT or Yang-Mills discriminator.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the scope explicitly denies geocenter, physical-map and identity admission.

adversarial_review.objection: The disclosed GW170817/GRB170817A rows could later be counted as a prospective holdout.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: HOLD-LC-001 remains RETROSPECTIVE and PROS-LOCK-001 remains EMPTY.

boundary: R-473 is a T0 claim-nonbearing finite raw-event feature index. It advances only the detector-frame feature portion of F_reg for two already hash-pinned TTE products. The physical owner, calibration, time-standard, geocenter, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, prospective, physical-identity, continuum and mass-gap gates remain open.
next_action: Use the feature index only as a frozen candidate-neutral input while requesting the missing source-owner calibration/time-standard/geocenter and statistical contracts. Do not score HOLD-LC-001 or infer dynamics. In the forward lane, continue the unchanged source-owned Q3LOCK -> common-core -> uniform-estimate order.
